text:
The air transparent, transparent

the sickle of morning,

the warm white mountains, the gestures of the waves,

all that sea, all that sea fulfilling

its profound task,

the sea lost in itself,

the sea, at that honeyed hour when instinct

hums like a drowsy bee…

Sun, love, lilies expanded, sea lilies,

Blond branches, tender and sensitive as bodies,

vast pale sands.


The air transparent, transparent

voices, silence.

On the shores of love, of the sea, of morning,

on the hot sand, trembling with whiteness,

each is a fruit ripening toward death.

translation.title: Noon
